U.S. Rep. Henry Cuellar (D-TX-28) is demanding answers about drilling work that began in the Rio Grande near Bridge 2, saying the community was given a different impression about what was happening in the river, according to KGNS (Oct. 21, 2026).

City of Laredo officials told KGNS they are contacting federal partners to confirm the drilling's purpose and what it could mean for Laredo and for international commerce through the port. Cuellar said he wants federal officials to explain why the work is moving ahead.

The drilling comes as the same KGNS reporting documented more buoys appearing along the Laredo riverbank, with markers seen going north and south of both Bridge 2 and the Colombia crossing over the last few days. Mayor Victor Treviño said over the weekend that witnessing the reinstallation of the buoy barrier system was "a sad day in the community's history," adding that he is in close contact with Cuellar and that both object to the installations.

Bridge 2 — the Juarez-Lincoln International Bridge — is one of Laredo's busiest international crossings, and any work in the river channel around it touches directly on the cross-border commerce that anchors the region's economy.

Cuellar, who is facing Republican challenger Tano Tijerina in the Nov. 3 general election, has positioned himself as the federal point of contact for the city's concerns. What exactly is being drilled, under whose authority, and why the work looks different from what residents were told remain unanswered — and Webb Watch 956 will keep asking until they are answered.

Sources: KGNS, reporting by Alex Cano, "Cuellar questions Rio Grande drilling near Bridge 2" and "Buoys reinstalled along Laredo riverbank draw objections" (Oct. 2026); Office of Congressman Henry Cuellar (cuellar.house.gov).

Webb Watch 956
excerpt: U.S. Rep. Henry Cuellar is questioning drilling work that began in the Rio Grande near Bridge 2, saying residents were given a different impression — while the city contacts federal partners to confirm the drilling's purpose and its impact on international commerce.
title: Cuellar questions drilling in the Rio Grande near Bridge 2, says community was given a different impression
